name: Alizé
description:
Alizé is a legal database and search engine for law professionals. With this connector, your assistant answers from the real documents instead of from memory, and gives you a citation you can open and check.

It searches the same corpus the Alizé platform runs on: more than 20 million documents across some 250 collections, ingested from the official publishers and updated daily. Coverage is fully developed for Luxembourg, Belgium, Spain and the European Union, alongside partial coverage of France and international law. Collections are complete rather than sampled, consolidated rather than scattered, and tracked for in-force status document by document.

Your assistant does the thinking. Alizé gives it the real law to think on.

You need an Alizé account and your firm's existing subscription. You reach the same collections you already have in Alizé, and nothing more. The connector reaches Alizé's legal databases only, so it never sees your own files.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alizé to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alizé to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.alize.lu/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alizé MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alizé provides these MCP tools: alize_ask, alize_flat_search, alize_regex_in_doc, alize_search, alize_search_in_doc, list_families, list_jurisdictions, list_types, and read_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alizé?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alizé in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, CiteLaw, and CookieYes.
Alizé requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alizé is developed by Alizé. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
